dedupe_keys.name: automated detection of on farm irrigation reservoirs in two critical groundwater regions of arkansas usda ars arcgis pro project

description: This USDA Agricultural Research Service dataset accompanies a study on automatically detecting on-farm irrigation reservoirs in two critical groundwater regions of Arkansas, where such reservoirs are a precursor to conjunctive management of surface and groundwater. It is a zipped ArcGIS Pro 3.1.2 project whose geodatabase holds the detection model and five maps: all water found in three 2023 study areas, the model's reservoirs classified by elevation difference, reservoir boundaries from Yeager and colleagues in 2017, every National Hydrography Dataset waterbody polygon in the areas, and open water and aquaculture polygons vectorised from the Cropland Data Layer. ISO 19139 metadata files were added on 13 May 2024 and the record was last updated on 21 November 2025. Coverage: three study areas in eastern Arkansas. Access: a free download from Ag Data Commons or Data.gov under a public domain label, needing ArcGIS Pro to open. Caveats: the project is a study snapshot, not a maintained inventory, and the detection depends on elevation data in low relief terrain. It supports irrigation storage, water balance and groundwater management studies, and relates to the IrrMap irrigation method dataset and the Upper Colorado irrigation inputs in the catalogue.
